name: VaultConnectionSignIn
description:
VaultConnectionSignIn records the sign-in behind a connection, so the
 platform can renew its token.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description:
When the access token expires, in Unix seconds. Zero means it does not
 expire.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.description: The OAuth client the sign-in used.

fields.name: AuthMethod
fields.description: How the sign-in was performed: "mcp_oauth" or "vendor_oauth".

fields.name: TokenEndpoint
fields.description: The token endpoint renewals are sent to.

fields.name: RefreshToken
fields.description: The refresh token. Never returned, and never delivered to a run.

fields.name: LoginApp
fields.description:
The login app the sign-in used, so a renewal presents the same client:
 "org:<OAuthApp id>" for an organization's app, "stigmer:<key>" for one of
 Stigmer's built-in login apps, and empty for a client registered with
 the address's own login server, which has no secret. Set by the server.
